statement: The entire directed marked family of finite bases with anabelian even subgroup, including every permuted semisimple even base and every finite joint base, has an actual relative-pronilpotent inverse limit with surjective pro-p kernel maps. Its exact common quotient with W is C54 times_C6 D_A, with D_A=Bhat/(K_D R_A), and the recorded action extends as identity on the entire new relative family using one simultaneous pro3 fixed conjugator. Both projection kernels are given by the exact source maps. The explicit A5^4 semidirect S4 source is generated by the displayed order2/order3 elements, has order311040000, and the remaining full-source kernel maps exactly onto A5^4. The top map is the retained canonical mod4 S4 map. D45 separately excludes a full-source lift of this recorded action.
